description: This file defines the CalendarUtils class for SuiteCRM, providing utility methods for managing calendar-related data such as retrieving first day of week, handling recurrence sequences, fetching field and time data, and managing repeated activities and their relationships.

classes.name: CalendarUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling calendar functionalities such as recurrence, data retrieval, and date calculations within the SuiteCRM platform.

methods.name: get_first_day_of_week
methods.description: Determines the first day of the week based on user settings and a given date.

methods.name: get_fields
methods.description: Returns the relevant fields for different module types (Meetings, Calls, Tasks) to be used in calendar views or data processing.

methods.name: get_time_data
methods.description: Calculates and returns timing-related data for a given SugarBean, including timestamps and durations.

methods.name: get_sendback_array
methods.description: Prepares an array of data representing a calendar event or task, suitable for AJAX responses or frontend display.

methods.name: get_sendback_repeat_data
methods.description: Retrieves or constructs recurrence-related data for a given SugarBean, handling recurring event sequences.

methods.name: build_repeat_sequence
methods.description: Generates an array of date strings representing the sequence of dates for recurring events based on recurrence parameters.

methods.name: save_repeat_activities
methods.description: Creates recurring activity entries in the database and links them with related entities, optimizing for performance.

methods.name: markRepeatDeleted
methods.description: Marks all activities in a recurrence series as deleted, updating related relationships accordingly.

methods.name: correctRecurrences
methods.description: Ensures recurrence chains are properly linked by updating parent IDs for child activities.
